dash.name: Dash
dash.text: Up to 3 hexes in a straight line, in one tick, for 1⚡. Click a hex in the direction to go.

whirl.name: Whirl
whirl.text: A spinning cut that hits every hex around you.

spark.name: Spark
spark.text: A bolt of raw element at an enemy up to 2 hexes away. Elemental damage, from your elemental attack. Landing it gives back 15 Spirit, so once it's going it keeps itself going. Needs a staff.
